candidates.accessibility: Boxes for Commons, Wikipedia and Wikidata, connected by arrows labelled with specific linkage operations.
candidates.credit: Jarekt (source work); Visite fortuitement prolongee (derivative work)
candidates.inversion: Do arrows represent actual reciprocal relationships, or only a proposed mapping?
candidates.motif: Explicit directional edges across different information systems
candidates.proposed_test: Use one source-linked CoMap graph; require distinct status and inverse semantics on each directional edge.
candidates.title: Commons / Wikipedia / Wikidata links

candidates.accessibility: Approximate distances of Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune from the Sun, using a shared legend and scale.
candidates.inversion: Is this scale exact for every distance, and is the visual orbital layout a dynamic measurement?
candidates.motif: Concentric orbital scale with a visible measurement legend
candidates.proposed_test: Render one CoOrb scale metaphor beside source-linked units and a clear conceptual-only label on the UI metaphor.
candidates.title: Gas Planet Orbits (PIA17304)

candidates.accessibility: Two scopes describe relationships involving people, documents and artwork, with explicitly typed directional predicates.
candidates.inversion: Does sharing a visual node imply the same graph scope, provenance or authority?
candidates.motif: Named/default graphs and source-bound, typed subject-predicate-object relations
candidates.proposed_test: Create one CoMap named-graph example with source provenance and a negative test for cross-graph conflation.
candidates.title: RDF 1.2 Primer: multiple graphs

candidates.accessibility: An interactive graph provides a text search to focus a subset of linked sources and their connections.
candidates.credit: Creative Commons Open Source / Linked Commons contributors
candidates.inversion: Does visual size or connection count masquerade as importance, authority or source independence?
candidates.motif: Explore many linked nodes by filtering, rather than displaying the entire graph at once
candidates.proposed_test: Compare CoOrb focus-plus-neighbors against a text-first list in a bounded first-use task.
candidates.title: Linked Commons network viewer
